newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's 1996 trade falls 9.0 pct to $1.996 billion.
newsitem.headline: Peru's 1996 trade falls 9.0 pct to $1.996 billion.

text.p: Peru's trade deficit fell 9.0 percent in 1996 to $1.996 billion from $2.185 billion in 1995, the Central Reserve Bank said Friday.

Exports grew six percent last year to $5.897 billion from $5.576 billion in 1995, the bank said. Meanwhile, in 1996 imports rose 2.0 percent to $7.893 billion, compared with $7.761 billion the previous year, the bank said.

Peru's traditional export sectors of minerals, oil, agriculture and fishing grew six percent in the first 11 months to $4.213 billion. The fastest growing traditional export sector was crude oil and products, which rose 46 percent to $353 million.
Non-traditional exports grew by 11 percent to $1.590 billion from $1.438 billion.
